events.title: Group Fitness Classes
events.content:
**Try a group fitness class and discover how movement can make you feel happier, stronger and more connected!** 

Whether you enjoy lifting weights, challenging your cardio, strengthening your core, grooving to the music or relaxing in yoga, we strive to offer accessible classes for all bodies and all levels. Group Fitness classes are FREE for all active Rec Sports members.

Rec Sports Group Fitness

events.label: Student Life
events.title: Career Studios Drop-In Resume Review at The Ohio Union
events.content:
Career Studios are welcoming, drop-in spaces designed to give students quick, practical career support from their peers. No appointment needed. Stop by anytime to connect with trained Student Peer Career Coaches who are ready to help with everyday career questions and next steps.

Peer Career Coaches can assist with:

*   Building or updating a resume
*   Searching for jobs or internships
*   Preparing for interviews
*   Connecting you with a professional Career Coach for individualized support

Each Career Studio is supported by professional career coaching staff and designed to make career guidance accessible and approachable for all students.

**Ohio Union - Keith B. Key Center for Student Leadership and Service (southwest corner on the 2nd floor)**

*   Mondays - Thursdays from 10 a.m.-4 p.m. 
*   Fridays from 10 a.m.-2 p.m.

Nancy Thompson  
[thompson.2947@osu.edu](mailto:thompson.2947@osu.edu)  
[More information](https://buckeyecommons.osu.edu/career-studios)
